top_signals.title: Strait of Hormuz Shipping Marks Slight Rise
top_signals.summary: Shipping traffic at the Strait of Hormuz rose slightly even as a standoff persisted between the United States and Iran, data showed on Thursday, while the market monitored Iran-Oman talks about the waterway.Visible commodity vessel transits at Hormuz totalled 10 on Wednesday…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UAE ‘spy sheikh’ backs 49% stake in Trump family’s crypto bank venture, WSJ reports
top_signals.summary: World Liberty’s proposed trust bank has preliminary federal approval as the Trump-backed crypto venture deepens its ties to a senior UAE official.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

New York and FMCSA will head to court in late September to fight over CDL rules and federal funding.

top_signals.title: Charles Schwab to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to crypto trading platform
top_signals.summary: Schwab Crypto began rolling out to clients in May with direct access to BTC and ETH trading and charges 75 basis points per transaction.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Private Credit Investors Prefer Being Trapped Than Take Loss
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Olivia Fishlow joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Bloomberg News reporting that Cox Capital Partners offered instant liquidity for some investors by purchasing their shares, up to $90 million worth, at an average 26% discount. The bids though saw mixed success, with some drawing no offers at all. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Gap announces new Old Navy CEO following sluggish quarterly sales
